facts.fact: The terms of reference treat Lei n.º 22/11 as the current legal framework to be mapped, and say the APD was formally instituted by that law; no commencement date is given, so as_of is the document's version date of 21 April 2026.
facts.system: Lei n.º 22/11 on Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The terms of reference state the APD was formally instituted by Lei n.º 22/11 with its organisation and functioning defined by Decreto Presidencial n.º 214/16, and refer to its current organic statute; as_of is the document's version date of 21 April 2026.

On 21 April 2026 the Instituto de Modernização Administrativa, under the World Bank-financed PADA project, issued terms of reference to procure a 12-week drafting of a new organic law for the APD, citing a revision of the data protection law that changes the APD's legal nature; expressions of interest were due 15 June 2026.
